gaps.quote: frame changes are row additions costing $O(V((fK)^\tau+1))$ at a node through chunk interchanges
gaps.note: The page asserts this overhead bound without saying why a row addition costs a chunk interchange of width about fK, how K enters, or why K is bounded by a power of the axis count d. The reader cannot check the (fK)^tau term in the layer recurrence from what the page gives; the paper (around line 2410) derives it from K <= d^c <= f^(c/beta) at internal nodes.

The claim is missing the hypothesis 0<tau. For s/W<=1 the sum has 1+log_m f terms, which is O(f^tau) only if tau>0 (for tau<=0 it is not). The paper states 0<tau<1 (lines 1500-1560 and 2395-2400; line 1344 gives 0<tau=sigma<1). The page also does not say that 1+log_m f is O(f^tau).
